author: ruseldust
quote:
English/Español

Rockstar put a tremendous amount of effort into the graphics and creating a massive game world, but in doing so, it neglected things that many of us consider essential to a great game: the excitement, the emotional connection with the player, and the overall experience it delivers.

GTA 6 overlooks something as fundamental as evoking emotions and connecting with players on a deeper level. This is something that should never be neglected. In an industry increasingly focused on graphical power, the quality and depth of the gaming experience are being left behind, even though those are precisely the things that keep players immersed and invested in a game.

I admire the graphical work, but it didn't make me feel anything deeper. Previous entries in the series offered more in that regard. This isn't an achievement, it isn't progress, and it isn't even a revolution for the GTA franchise. That's disappointing.

This review and rating may seem harsh to some, but I believe it's important for us as gamers to let the industry know that maintaining a balance between technical achievements and the depth of the gaming experience matters to us.

GTA 6 is not a balanced game, and we cannot allow the industry to keep moving in this direction. We need genuine commitment to deeper storytelling, emotional impact, innovative gameplay mechanics, artistic direction, and the overall experience of the entire work—not just graphical eye candy and inflated expectations designed to drive sales.

--------------------------------

Rockstar dedicó un esfuerzo enorme a los gráficos y a la creación de un mundo de juego masivo, pero al hacerlo, descuidó aspectos que muchos consideramos esenciales para una gran obra: la emoción, la conexión emocional con el jugador y la experiencia general que ofrece.

GTA 6 pasa por alto algo tan fundamental como evocar emociones y conectar con los jugadores a un nivel más profundo. Esto es algo que nunca debería descuidarse. En una industria cada vez más centrada en la potencia gráfica, la calidad y la profundidad de la experiencia de juego están quedando relegadas, a pesar de que son precisamente los elementos que mantienen a los jugadores inmersos e involucrados en un título.

Admiro el trabajo gráfico, pero no me hizo sentir nada profundo. Entregas anteriores de la saga ofrecieron más en ese sentido. Esto no es un logro, no es progreso y ni siquiera supone una revolución para la franquicia GTA. Es decepcionante.

Esta reseña y calificación pueden parecer excesivamente duras para algunos, pero considero importante que, como jugadores, le hagamos saber a la industria que nos importa mantener un equilibrio entre los logros técnicos y la profundidad de la experiencia de juego.

GTA 6 no es un juego equilibrado y no podemos permitir que la industria siga avanzando en esta dirección. Necesitamos un compromiso genuino con una narrativa más profunda, impacto emocional, mecánicas de juego innovadoras, dirección artística y la experiencia integral de toda la obra; no solo atractivo visual y expectativas infladas diseñadas para impulsar las ventas.

author: ruseldust
quote: I'm a young gamer, and I never got to play the original version. I finally had the opportunity to experience this legendary game, and now I understand why it's considered the greatest game of all time.Among all the shooters, FIFA, and GTA games out there, Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a true gem, a refreshing game that offers something different.Thanks to its artistic direction, I've learned to appreciate nature again. There's a park near my house, and whenever I walk among the trees, I imagine I'm playing Zelda. Thanks to this game, I've rediscovered my imagination.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
